about_me_desc: Developing with intent, designing with passion, delivering with precision
about_me_introduction: A <green>Full Stack Developer</green> with <blue>3+ years</blue> of experience, specializing in Node.js, TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks, who has shipped 10+ production projects for web and mobile.
about_me_skills: I build scalable web and mobile applications with Node.js, Express, NestJS, React, Next.js and React Native, backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis, and shipped with Docker, GitHub Actions and AWS.
about_me_more_introduction: I care about maintainable code and solving real-world problems. I am deepening my knowledge of backend architecture, cloud technologies and system design, with the long-term goal of becoming a Senior Full Stack Engineer and technical leader.
